question: Find the average of first 148 odd natural numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first n odd natural numbers is always equal to n.

Here, the number of odd terms given is n = 148.

Average = 148.

**∴ The correct answer is 148.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sequence of the first 148 odd natural numbers.

**Formula Used:**

The nth odd natural number = 2n − 1

Average of an Arithmetic Progression (AP) = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2
